id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('absensi_praktikum_id_seq'::regclass),
  modul_id bigint NOT NULL,
  daftar_praktikan_id uuid NOT NULL,
  tanggal date NOT NULL,
  status character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'hadir'::character varying,
  keterangan text,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_prak_absensi_praktikum_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT absensi_praktikum_daftar_praktikan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (daftar_praktikan_id) REFERENCES public.eo_prak_daftar_praktikan(id),
  CONSTRAINT absensi_praktikum_modul_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (modul_id) REFERENCES public.eo_prak_modul_praktikum(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('asprak_praktikum_id_seq'::regclass),
  praktikum_id uuid NOT NULL,
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  role character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'asprak'::character varying,
  deskripsi text,
  deleted_at timestamp without time zone,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_prak_asprak_praktikum_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT asprak_praktikum_praktikum_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (praktikum_id) REFERENCES public.eo_prak_praktikum(id),
  CONSTRAINT asprak_praktikum_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id uuid NOT NULL,
  praktikum_id uuid NOT NULL,
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  status character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'terdaftar'::character varying,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  kelompok character varying,
  shift character varying,
  CONSTRAINT eo_prak_daftar_praktikan_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT daftar_praktikan_praktikum_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (praktikum_id) REFERENCES public.eo_prak_praktikum(id),
  CONSTRAINT daftar_praktikan_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_approval_id_seq'::regclass),
  surat_id bigint NOT NULL,
  approver_id bigint NOT NULL,
  urutan integer NOT NULL,
  status character varying NOT NULL,
  file_ttd character varying,
  role_approver character varying NOT NULL,
  catatan text,
  tanggal timestamp without time zone,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_approval_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_approval_approver_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (approver_id) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_approval_surat_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (surat_id) REFERENCES public.eo_surat(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_approval_config_id_seq'::regclass),
  jenis_id bigint NOT NULL,
  urutan integer NOT NULL,
  role character varying NOT NULL,
  is_required boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_approval_config_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT lg_eo_approval_config_jenis_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (jenis_id) REFERENCES public.eo_jenis_surat(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_arsip_surat_id_seq'::regclass),
  surat_id bigint NOT NULL,
  kategori character varying NOT NULL,
  tanggal_arsip date NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_arsip_surat_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_arsip_surat_surat_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (surat_id) REFERENCES public.eo_surat(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_aturan_peminjaman_id_seq'::regclass),
  kode_aturan character varying NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  nama character varying NOT NULL,
  nilai integer NOT NULL,
  satuan character varying NOT NULL,
  deskripsi text,
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  updated_by bigint,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_aturan_peminjaman_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_aturan_peminjaman_updated_by_foreign FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_audit_logs_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint,
  action character varying NOT NULL,
  subject_type character varying,
  subject_id character varying,
  description character varying NOT NULL,
  old_data json,
  new_data json,
  created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  cerc_deleted_at timestamp without time zone,
  cerc_deleted_by bigint,
  CONSTRAINT eo_audit_logs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_audit_logs_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_berkas_pendukung_id_seq'::regclass),
  peminjaman_id bigint NOT NULL,
  nama_file character varying NOT NULL,
  path_file character varying NOT NULL,
  tipe_file character varying NOT NULL,
  ukuran_file integer NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT eo_berkas_pendukung_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_berkas_pendukung_peminjaman_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (peminjaman_id) REFERENCES public.eo_peminjaman(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_disposisi_surat_masuk_id_seq'::regclass),
  surat_masuk_id bigint NOT NULL,
  penerima_id bigint NOT NULL,
  status_baca boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  catatan text,
  tanggal_disposisi timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_disposisi_surat_masuk_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_disposisi_surat_masuk_penerima_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (penerima_id) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_disposisi_surat_masuk_surat_masuk_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (surat_masuk_id) REFERENCES public.eo_surat_masuk(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_field_template_id_seq'::regclass),
  template_id bigint NOT NULL,
  nama_field character varying NOT NULL,
  tipe_input character varying NOT NULL,
  is_required boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  urutan integer NOT NULL,
  options text,
  default_value character varying,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_field_template_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_field_template_template_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (template_id) REFERENCES public.eo_template_surat(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_import_log_id_seq'::regclass),
  admin_id bigint NOT NULL,
  nama_file character varying NOT NULL,
  jumlah_record integer NOT NULL,
  status character varying NOT NULL,
  catatan text,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_import_log_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_import_log_admin_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (admin_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_isi_surat_id_seq'::regclass),
  surat_id bigint NOT NULL,
  field_id bigint NOT NULL,
  value text,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_isi_surat_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_isi_surat_field_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (field_id) REFERENCES public.eo_field_template(id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_isi_surat_surat_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (surat_id) REFERENCES public.eo_surat(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_jadwal_kuliah_id_seq'::regclass),
  ruangan_id bigint NOT NULL,
  import_log_id bigint,
  hari character varying NOT NULL,
  jam_mulai time without time zone NOT NULL,
  jam_selesai time without time zone NOT NULL,
  mata_kuliah character varying NOT NULL,
  dosen character varying NOT NULL,
  kelas character varying NOT NULL,
  semester character varying NOT NULL,
  tahun_ajaran character varying NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_jadwal_kuliah_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_jadwal_kuliah_import_log_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (import_log_id) REFERENCES public.eo_import_log(id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_jadwal_kuliah_ruangan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (ruangan_id) REFERENCES public.eo_ruangan(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_jenis_surat_id_seq'::regclass),
  nama_jenis character varying NOT NULL,
  kode_surat character varying NOT NULL,
  deskripsi text,
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  klasifikasi_id bigint,
  CONSTRAINT eo_jenis_surat_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_jenis_surat_klasifikasi_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (klasifikasi_id) REFERENCES public.eo_ms_klasifikasi(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_kerja_praktik_id_seq'::regclass),
  nim character varying NOT NULL,
  mahasiswa_id bigint NOT NULL,
  dosen_pembimbing_id bigint,
  judul_kp character varying,
  instansi_kp character varying,
  tanggal_mulai date,
  tanggal_selesai date,
  status_kp character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pra-KP'::character varying,
  is_acc_admin boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  deleted_at timestamp without time zone,
  ipk numeric,
  sks_diambil smallint,
  kelas character varying,
  periode_id bigint,
  keterangan_status character varying,
  is_data_instansi_locked boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  CONSTRAINT eo_kerja_praktik_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kerja_praktik_dosen_pembimbing_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (dosen_pembimbing_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kp_dosen(id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kerja_praktik_mahasiswa_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (mahasiswa_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kp_mahasiswa(id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kerja_praktik_periode_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (periode_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kp_periode(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_kp_balancing_id_seq'::regclass),
  kp_id bigint NOT NULL,
  mahasiswa_id bigint NOT NULL,
  dosen_id bigint,
  status character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'::character varying CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::character varying::text, 'finalized'::character varying::text])),
  assigned_by bigint,
  assigned_at timestamp without time zone,
  finalized_at timestamp without time zone,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_balancing_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_balancing_assigned_by_foreign FOREIGN KEY (assigned_by) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_balancing_dosen_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (dosen_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kp_dosen(id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_balancing_kp_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (kp_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kerja_praktik(id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_balancing_mahasiswa_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (mahasiswa_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kp_mahasiswa(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_kp_dokumen_id_seq'::regclass),
  kp_id bigint NOT NULL,
  jenis_dokumen character varying NOT NULL,
  file_path character varying NOT NULL,
  status_validasi character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'menunggu'::character varying,
  tanggal_upload timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  is_published boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  file_name character varying,
  phase character varying CHECK (phase::text = ANY (ARRAY['pra_kp'::character varying::text, 'saat_kp'::character varying::text, 'pasca_kp'::character varying::text])),
  approval_status character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::character varying CHECK (approval_status::text = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::character varying::text, 'approved'::character varying::text, 'rejected'::character varying::text, 'revision'::character varying::text])),
  approved_by bigint,
  approved_at timestamp without time zone,
  revision_note text,
  nilai_input_mahasiswa double precision,
  nilai_validasi_koordinator double precision,
  nilai_status character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::character varying CHECK (nilai_status::text = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::character varying::text, 'valid'::character varying::text, 'rejected'::character varying::text])),
  deleted_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_dokumen_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_dokumen_kp_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (kp_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kerja_praktik(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_kp_dosen_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  nip character varying NOT NULL,
  nama_lengkap character varying NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  kuota_maksimal integer DEFAULT 10,
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_dosen_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_dosen_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_kp_komponen_nilai_id_seq'::regclass),
  periode_id bigint NOT NULL,
  nama_komponen character varying NOT NULL,
  bobot integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  role_penilai character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dosen_pembimbing'::character varying CHECK (role_penilai::text = ANY (ARRAY['dosen_pembimbing'::character varying::text, 'koordinator'::character varying::text])),
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  master_rubrik_id bigint,
  kode character varying,
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_komponen_nilai_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_komponen_nilai_master_rubrik_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (master_rubrik_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kp_master_rubrik(id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_komponen_nilai_periode_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (periode_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kp_periode(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_kp_mahasiswa_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  nim character varying NOT NULL,
  nama_lengkap character varying NOT NULL,
  prodi character varying NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_mahasiswa_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_mahasiswa_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_kp_nilai_detail_id_seq'::regclass),
  kp_id bigint NOT NULL,
  komponen_id bigint NOT NULL,
  nilai_angka numeric,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  deleted_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_nilai_detail_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_nilai_detail_komponen_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (komponen_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kp_komponen_nilai(id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_nilai_detail_kp_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (kp_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kerja_praktik(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_kp_pengumuman_id_seq'::regclass),
  judul character varying NOT NULL,
  konten text NOT NULL,
  tipe character varying NOT NULL,
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_by bigint,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  is_published boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  lampiran character varying,
  deleted_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_pengumuman_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_kp_penilaian_id_seq'::regclass),
  kp_id bigint NOT NULL,
  nilai_akhir double precision,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  deleted_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_penilaian_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_penilaian_kp_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (kp_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kerja_praktik(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_kp_periode_id_seq'::regclass),
  tahun_ajaran character varying NOT NULL,
  semester character varying NOT NULL CHECK (semester::text = ANY (ARRAY['Ganjil'::character varying::text, 'Genap'::character varying::text])),
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  tanggal_buka date,
  tanggal_tutup date,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  pra_kp_mulai date,
  pra_kp_akhir date,
  pra_kp_pengingat date,
  saat_kp_mulai date,
  saat_kp_akhir date,
  saat_kp_pengingat date,
  pasca_kp_mulai date,
  pasca_kp_akhir date,
  pasca_kp_pengingat date,
  kelas_dibuka text,
  deleted_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_periode_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_kp_seminar_id_seq'::regclass),
  kp_id bigint NOT NULL,
  tanggal_seminar date NOT NULL,
  waktu_seminar time without time zone NOT NULL,
  ruangan character varying,
  status_validasi_syarat character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'belum'::character varying,
  path_undangan character varying,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  status_validasi_dosen character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::character varying CHECK (status_validasi_dosen::text = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::character varying::text, 'approved'::character varying::text, 'rejected'::character varying::text])),
  catatan_dosen text,
  deleted_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_seminar_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_seminar_kp_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (kp_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kerja_praktik(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_kp_settings_id_seq'::regclass),
  key character varying NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  value text,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_settings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_kp_template_id_seq'::regclass),
  title character varying NOT NULL,
  description text,
  phase character varying NOT NULL CHECK (phase::text = ANY (ARRAY['pra_kp'::character varying::text, 'saat_kp'::character varying::text, 'pasca_kp'::character varying::text])),
  file_name character varying,
  file_path character varying,
  file_type character varying,
  is_required boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  uploaded_by bigint,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  periode_id bigint,
  is_downloadable boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  is_uploadable boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  approver_role character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'koordinator'::character varying,
  deleted_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_template_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_kp_template_periode_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (periode_id) REFERENCES public.eo_kp_periode(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_lampiran_id_seq'::regclass),
  surat_id bigint NOT NULL,
  nama_file character varying NOT NULL,
  path_file character varying NOT NULL,
  tipe_file character varying NOT NULL,
  uploaded_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_lampiran_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_lampiran_surat_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (surat_id) REFERENCES public.eo_surat(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_log_aktivitas_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  aksi character varying NOT NULL,
  modul character varying NOT NULL,
  detail text,
  ip_address character varying,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_log_aktivitas_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_log_aktivitas_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_matkul_praktikum_id_seq'::regclass),
  kode character varying NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  nama character varying NOT NULL,
  sks integer NOT NULL,
  semester bigint,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_prak_matkul_praktikum_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_mi_barang_id_seq'::regclass),
  kategori_id bigint NOT NULL,
  satuan_id bigint NOT NULL,
  nama_barang character varying NOT NULL,
  foto character varying,
  asal_lab character varying,
  jumlah_stok integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_mi_barang_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_mi_barang_kategori_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (kategori_id) REFERENCES public.eo_mi_kategori(id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_mi_barang_satuan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (satuan_id) REFERENCES public.eo_mi_satuan(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_mi_kategori_id_seq'::regclass),
  nama_kategori character varying NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_mi_kategori_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_mi_satuan_id_seq'::regclass),
  nama_satuan character varying NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_mi_satuan_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_mr_blacklists_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint,
  alasan text,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_mr_blacklists_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_mr_blacklists_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id uuid NOT NULL,
  ruangan_id bigint NOT NULL,
  tipe_jadwal character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'spesifik'::character varying,
  kategori character varying NOT NULL,
  hari smallint,
  tanggal_spesifik date,
  jam_mulai time without time zone NOT NULL,
  jam_selesai time without time zone NOT NULL,
  tgl_mulai_efektif date,
  tgl_selesai_efektif date,
  mata_kuliah character varying,
  kode_mk character varying,
  kelas character varying,
  sks integer,
  kuota integer,
  pengampu text,
  keterangan character varying,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT eo_mr_jadwal_internal_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT eo_mr_jadwal_internal_ruangan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (ruangan_id) REFERENCES public.eo_mr_ruangans(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('eo_mr_peminjamans_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  ruangan_id bigint NOT NULL,
  nomor_telepon character varying,
  tujuan text NOT NULL,
  tanggal_pinjam date NOT NULL,
  jam_mulai time without time zone NOT NULL,
  jam_selesai time without time zone NOT NULL,
  berkas_pendukung character varying,
  status character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'menunggu'::character varying CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['menunggu'::character varying::text, 'disetujui'::character varying::text, 'ditolak'::character varying::text, 'dibatalkan'::character varying::text])),
  alasan_penolakan text,
  waktu_approval timestamp without time zone,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  created_by bigint,
  deleted_at timestamp without time zone,
  is_hidden_by_user boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
